 Kathmandu ؛ Kathmandu lost its seventh wicket against Chitwan Rhinos
 Ratopati
 November 09, 2026
 Read in Nepali
 Kathmandu. Kathmandu Gurkhas have lost their seventh wicket against Chitwan Rhinos in the Nepal Premier League (NPL).
 On Monday, Kathmandu, who lost the toss and batted first at the TU International Cricket Ground in Kirtipur, lost their seventh wicket after scoring 168 runs in 19 overs.
 Kathmandu's Mohammad Adil Alam was out for 9 runs off 8 balls. Rijan Dhakal bowled him out.
 Chitwan's Rijan Dhakal took 3 wickets, and Sikandar Raza took 2 wickets. Kamal Airee and Dan Mousley took 1 wicket each.
